description: Sofa.1 combines an intuitive dashboard for scheduled micro-check-ins with an empathetic voice chatbot. Powered by Edge AI, it processes data locally for fast, reliable monitoring. The chatbot collects vital information and analyzes speech for biomarkers of stress and fatigue. Using predictive analytics on multimodal data, Sofa.1 detects potential physical and mental health risks before symptoms appear, automatically triggering personalized action plans to support astronaut well-being and mission
